mapper.sql:
c.id, c.user_id, c.sku_id, c.category_id, c.brand_id, c.store_id, c.quantity, c.selected, c.create_by, c.update_by, c.create_time, c.update_time, p.product_code, p.product_name, sk.product_id AS productId, COALESCE(sk.sku_image, p.main_image) AS main_image, sk.product_price, sk.spec_text AS specText,
(SELECT IFNULL(SUM(i.stock - i.locked_stock), 0) FROM shop_erp_inventory i WHERE i.sku_id = sk.id AND i.is_deleted = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shop_erp_warehouse w WHERE w.id = i.warehouse_id AND w.is_deleted = 0 AND w.status = 1)) AS available_stock, cat.category_name, b.brand_name, b.logo AS brand_logo, st.store_name, u.nickname, u.username

FROM shop_consumer_cart c LEFT JOIN shop_product_sku sk ON sk.id = c.sku_id AND sk.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN shop_product p ON p.id = sk.product_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN shop_category cat ON cat.id = c.category_id AND cat.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN shop_brand b ON b.id = c.brand_id AND b.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN shop_store st ON st.id = c.store_id AND st.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = c.user_id
mapper.select:
SELECT , CASE WHEN p.status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS buyable
WHERE c.is_deleted = 0 AND c.user_id = #{userId} AND sk.id IS NOT NULL AND p.id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY c.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE shop_consumer_cart SET quantity = quantity + #{delta}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND sku_id = #{skuId} AND is_deleted = 0

UPDATE shop_consumer_cart SET is_deleted = 0, quantity = #{quantity}, selected = 1, category_id = #{categoryId}, brand_id = #{brandId}, store_id = #{storeId}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND sku_id = #{skuId}

UPDATE shop_consumer_cart c SET c.selected = #{selected}, c.update_by = #{updateBy}, c.update_time = NOW() WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.is_deleted = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shop_product_sku sk JOIN shop_product p ON p.id = sk.product_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 AND p.status = 1 WHERE sk.id = c.sku_id AND sk.is_deleted = 0)
